$comment: Protected. Machine-readable form of the SLO table in the constitution (Principle VII). Metric names are proposals; 001 (observability baseline) may rename them with Antn's approval. ci/slo-check.ts fails if any metric here is missing from the telemetry registry once it exists.

slos.name: Verdict saved
slos.objective: >= 99.9% of verdict requests succeed; p95 latency < 300 ms

slos.name: Next record ready
slos.objective: p95 < 500 ms to return the next record with its audio source

slos.name: Inventory freshness
slos.objective: Nightly full sync succeeds within 26 h of the previous one, 99% of the time

slos.name: Sold-record removal
slos.objective: A record sold in Common Ground leaves every pile within 20 min, 99% of the time

slos.name: Staff checkout correctness
slos.objective: 100% of checkouts marked paid had zero total mismatch; >= 99% of started checkouts complete or stop safely

slos.name: Audio resolvable
slos.objective: >= 95% of records that have an audio source resolve to something playable

slos.name: Notification delivery
slos.objective: >= 99% of push notifications sent within 5 min of their trigger (outside quiet hours)
